results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage of Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing how social media algorithms and Meta's political content policies impact political visibility, democratic processes, and election dynamics.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Press announcement detailing Fabio Giglietto's study on Meta's political content reduction policies, which led to a parliamentary inquiry in the European Parliament and was highlighted on Rai3's investigative show Report.
